task.description: Produce a backend design artefact at src/design/idn-03-role-based-access.md for requirement IDN-03 (Role-based access). Define the authoritative Stage 5 role-permission matrix, additive-role evaluation semantics, and endpoint-to-permission mapping with explicit default-to-PLATFORM_ADMIN behavior for uncovered endpoints. Specify row-level filtering behavior for GET /tasks for TASK_WORKER, policy checks for create definition and cancel instance operations, and integration boundaries with IDN-01 users, API-08 bearer auth role extraction, and IDN-04 token role claims. Include policy evaluation flow, error taxonomy and HTTP mappings (403 vs row-filter), and trace every acceptance criterion to at least one concrete design element. No source code changes in this step.
acceptance_criteria: Every IDN-03 acceptance criterion is mapped to explicit design elements
Role matrix and additive union semantics are fully specified
Default authorization behavior for endpoints outside the matrix is explicit
GET /tasks row-level filtering behavior for TASK_WORKER is specified
Create-definition and cancel-instance authorization checks are specified
Dependencies and integration points with IDN-01, IDN-04, and API-08 are explicit

result.summary: Design artefact for IDN-03 role-based access including authoritative Stage 5 role matrix, additive-role semantics, endpoint mapping, row-level task filtering, and integration boundaries.
